title: Skeleton Chordalities
summary: We study new higher-dimensional analogs of graph chordality and review the existing ones. Our main results for simplicial complexes are: (1) $Δ$ skeleton-E-chordal $\Rightarrow$ $Δ^\vee$ vertex-decomposable $\Rightarrow$ $Δ$ skeleton-clique-chordal. Moreover, for subflag complexes, $Δ$ skeleton-E-chordal $\Longleftrightarrow$ $Δ^\vee$ vertex-decomposable. (For $d=1$ this boils down to ``$G$ chordal $\Longleftrightarrow$ $G^\vee$ vertex-decomposable'', a result closely related to Fröberg's theorem.)
